title: Weight of v(M,θ) as θH^n⌞M restricted to a Borel hull of the tangent-point set (parent steps 1, 3)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U and M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with V = v(M,θ) (IsVarifoldOf V M θ). Let M* := {x ∈ M : ∃ S ∈ G(N,n) such that M has weighted approximate tangent space S.plane at x with respect to θ (Simon Ch. 3, 1.7)} and ν := (H^n⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ. Then there is a Borel set T ⊇ M* with μ_V = ν⌞T, and μ_V(B) = ∫⁻_{M*∩B} ofReal(θ) dH^n for every Borel B ⊆ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsVarifoldOf V M θ → ∃ T : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet T ∧ {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane} ⊆ T ∧ V.weight = (((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M).withDensity fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ x)).restrict T ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → V.weight B = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane} ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
